Through live mentor sessions and hands-on datasets, you'll build core skills in data cleaning, exploration (EDA), visualization, reporting, and storytelling with dashboards. Each project is mapped to real-world use cases in domains like Sales, Finance, and HR.
The course also sets the foundation for future roles in Data Science, BI, and Generative AI. With dedicated placement assistance, certifications, and personalized career mentorship, you'll be fully equipped to crack analyst interviews and excel in data-first roles.
